notes.title: Attention!
notes.content:
Hello, we made a big mistake that we withdrew the keys to this game, but we had to do it. Now we want to apologize to you. In the mail that will be below you will need to send any proof that you owned this game and I will send you the key. Nothing more to do.
Also, we will continue to hold a free draw of other games from our publisher. We have problems that we did not know how to solve. But now you have suggested to us and we will gladly do it. After all, only we are to blame for this situation.
We apologize again, with respect W. T. B.
excellente23@yandex.ru
